blocks.text: Legendary rock band TOTO is set to return to the Philippines for two anticipated performances. The band will take the stage at the SM Mall of Asia Arena on March 29, 2027, followed by a performance at SM Seaside Cebu Arena on March 30, 2027, bringing their iconic hits and signature sound to Filipino fans once again. On January 7, 1977, the founding line-up of Toto came together for the first time at Davlen Studios in North Hollywood, California to begin tracking demos that would become the band’s debut album.
